A '''bunker''' in the [[Gallo Mountains/Legends|Gallo Mountains]] of the planet [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] was used by a group of [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Mining/Legends|miners]] as their base of operations at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Description==
[[File:Mountain_poacher_bunker_interior.jpg|thumb|250px|The largest room of the bunker]]
The building was located close to the [[Zaprin Estate]],<ref name="SWG:HC">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Medic|House Call|Naboo}}</ref> at the foot of the Gallo Mountains, near the edge of the [[Lianorm Swamp/Legends|Lianorm Swamp]], many kilometers southeast of the [[Varykino/Legends|Lake Retreat]]. Most of the bunker was built underground. Only the small top level with the only entrance to the bunker was visible above ground. The two underground levels featured several rooms, used for various purposes. Several computer terminals were in use by the poachers. The biggest room on the lowest floor was used as a dining-hall.<ref name="SWG:CtT" />

==History==
The bunker served as base of operations for a group of miners after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="SWG:CtT" />

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> a group of criminals, the [[Mountain Poachers]], and their trained [[Narglatch/Legends|narglatchs]] took over the bunker. One of the miners, [[Galuf Cardaan]], then contacted [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Snopel]],<ref name="SWG:CtT" /> a retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Commando/Legends|commando]],<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Commando|Commando|Tansarii Point Station}}</ref> in order to got rid of the poachers. Snopel therefore dispatched a group of commandos under training to deal with the criminals. The commandos attacked the bunker, killing some poachers and narglatches in the assault, and successfully reclaimed the building.<ref name="SWG:CtT" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mountain poacher bunker was a location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CtT" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The bunker was added to the game upon the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]," a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref> In the game, the bunker was only titled as the '''Occupied Bunker'''.<ref name="SWG:CtT" />
